tech_stack.name: APM CLI
tech_stack.usage_context: Package manager for agent context; used to compile, pack, install packages. Referenced in apm.lock.yaml (apm_version: 0.16.1) and AGENTS.md (APM Version: 0.16.1).

conventions: APM .apm/ directory layout: skills/, instructions/, prompts/, agents/ subdirectories for primitives
Git tags follow v{version} pattern (e.g., v0.1.0) for APM version pinning
apm compile generates AGENTS.md and per-target output from .apm/ source
apm pack produces build/<name>-<version>/ bundle and marketplace.json
APM lockfile (apm.lock.yaml) pins resolved commits and content hashes
AGENTS.md is auto-generated — do not edit manually (stated in file header)
Skills: one subdirectory per skill under .apm/skills/, each with SKILL.md

hard: apm.yml must have name and version fields
.apm/ directory must exist with at least one primitive subdirectory for .apm/ package type
Git tags are required for version pinning (latest, release, sha)
apm compile must succeed to produce AGENTS.md and build output
AGENTS.md is generated — source primitives live under .apm/
soft: apm.yml.description recommended for apm view / apm search
docs/ directory recommended for architecture/contribution docs
CI/CD pipeline recommended for automated validation and release
compatibility: Targets declared in apm.yml: copilot, gemini, opencode
Consumer install via: apm install dbensmith/agent-library

key_dirs: .apm/skills/ — 4 local skills: home-assistant-env, marketplace-listings, organize-tax-docs-canada, uv
.agents/skills/ — Deployed runtime skills (local + 5 remote APM deps)
build/agent-library-0.1.0/ — Prior build output with instructions/, agents/, skills/, plugin.json

key_components.name: apm.yml
responsibility: Package manifest: name, version, 5 remote APM deps, 3 targets, includes: auto

key_components.name: apm.lock.yaml
responsibility: Pins resolved commits and content hashes for all dependencies

key_components.name: plugin.json
responsibility: Plugin metadata: name, version, author, license

key_components.name: AGENTS.md
responsibility: Auto-generated entry point; references .apm/instructions/library.instructions.md which does NOT exist in source

key_components.name: build output
responsibility: Prior apm compile output; contains files not in .apm/ source (instructions/, agents/)

purpose: Package manifest — validate against APM manifest schema

Aspirational docs — check claimed .apm/prompts/, docs/ dirs exist

Source primitives — inventory only has skills/ subdir
Deployed runtime tree — 9 skill dirs (4 local + 5 remote deps)

gotchas.text: AGENTS.md references .apm/instructions/library.instructions.md which does not exist in source — apm compile may fail or produce broken output
Zero git tags — version pinning (latest, release, sha) is completely non-functional
README.md claims .apm/prompts/ and docs/ exist but neither directory is present
Build directory has agents/marketplace-listings.agent.md but no .apm/agents/ source — unclear if agent is intended to ship
Current work is on feature branch 'humble-spider'; main branch state may differ from working tree

prior_decisions.decision: Repository migrated to APM format (commit efd7a77: 'refactor(apm): migrate repository structure to APM format')
Skills migrated from local to remote APM dependencies (commit ee8384e: 'chore: migrate skills to remote APM dependencies (#1)')
rationale: 5 skills now declared as apm dependencies instead of vendored locally

prior_decisions.decision: AGENTS.md is auto-generated by apm compile, not hand-authored
rationale: File header states: 'Generated by APM CLI from distributed .apm/ primitives'

learnings: Readiness report synthesized 13 gaps into single NO-GO verdict: zero git tags blocks version-pinned install
GAP-01 (CRITICAL) is trivially fixable (git tag); the harder gaps are GAP-02/GAP-03 (missing source primitives)
Pre-flight checklist validated 8 conditions; 4 are NO, 2 UNVERIFIED, 1 PARTIAL — only 1 fully met today
Build directory is stale artifact: 8 skills vs 9 in lockfile; instructions+agents present in build but absent from .apm/ source
Phase 1 remediation (GAP-01→GAP-02+GAP-03→GAP-04) is the minimum viable path to a release-capable package
PRD produced 7 BDD action items covering all 13 gaps; critical path is Actions 2+3→4→7 (~30 min serial work)
All 13 gaps mapped to action items: GAP-01→A1, GAP-02→A2, GAP-03→A3, GAP-04/GAP-10→A4, GAP-06/GAP-08/GAP-09→A5, GAP-05/GAP-12/GAP-13→A6, GAP-07→A7
Definition of Done: 4 install modes (latest, tag #v0.1.0, SHA, semver range) must all succeed; 12-item pre-flight checklist; one-shot verification command chain
